scope: Read-only three-case contact and rolling-wrist audit; no physics changes or actor/collider identity beyond logged filters.

definitions.packet_normal_force: Sum of positive PhysX normal-contact magnitudes for each pad rigid body filtered against /World/Waffle; it is not a net vector or a prismatic actuator force.
definitions.packet_net_vector: Vector sum of filtered normal contact forces at scene sampling; pad_force is net all-body pad contact force.
definitions.gel: 8Hz selected inner-face active-patch compression; not all pad rigid-body forces.
definitions.wrist: Recorded125Hz proxy input; replay below uses exact frozen rolling baseline order,60N/15Nm and3/10=.3s debounce.
definitions.threshold_intervals: Consecutive samples at approximately15Hz. Observed span and neighboring sample bounds, not proven continuous force duration or unsampled peak.
definitions.separation: PhysX signed contact separation in metres where stored; negative is overlap. No missing values imputed.

gripper.geometry_source: Rounded pad/backing contact hulls and70mm effective custom-pad aperture fitted against measured grasp; nominal bare Robotiqstroke remains85mm. Contact/material parameters are uncalibrated estimates.

tactile_safety_thresholds.depth_note: The recorded configuration key is tactile_depth_limit; calibrated proxy field depth uses mm. No threshold is changed by this audit.

limits: No contact collider/shape IDs: /World/Waffle establishes contacting body only; exact pad backing/gel-mesh collider remains unknown.

Contact force is summed magnitude; do not compare directly to prismatic maxForce as if it were actuator load. Axis contact component can also exceed drive cap during constrained arm motion/inertia/contact.
High compliant overlap and frozen adaptive wrist baseline are realism/safety-model limitations; simulation success is not hardware calibration.
Original successful source did not record signed separations, so its penetration cannot be compared quantitatively.
score_preservation: Secondary contact/safety-model diagnosis only. No frozen physical outcome score, valid flag, task threshold, campaign denominator, or source is modified.
provenance: SHA256 values are computed on authoritative compute3 raw files and exact runtime source files; source files are read-only. Every consumed trace/config file is enumerated per case.
